site.pageTitle: Sumba with Tinus | Local guide and airport transfers in Sumba, Indonesia
site.metaDescription: Airport transfers and trips in Sumba, Indonesia with local guide Tinus. Waterfalls, beaches, traditional villages and the Weekuri lagoon in West and East Sumba.
site.headline: See Sumba with a local guide
site.intro: Airport pickups in Tambolaka and Waingapu, and trips to waterfalls, beaches, hills and traditional villages across the island.

heroPhoto.alt: A row of traditional Sumbanese houses with tall thatched roofs along a stone-paved village street

contact.whatsappMessage: Hello Tinus! I found your website and I would like to plan a trip in Sumba.

servicesIntro: Tell Tinus which places you want to see and he will plan the route with you.

services.title: Airport transfers
services.summary: A ride between the airport and your hotel, homestay or resort.

services.title: West Sumba trips
services.summary: Choose your stops in the west of the island: waterfalls, traditional villages, beaches and the Weekuri lagoon.

services.title: East Sumba trips
services.summary: Choose your stops in the east of the island: waterfalls, beaches and rolling hills.

placesIntro: Every stop here is a suggestion. Mix places from the list, or ask Tinus about somewhere that is not on it.

placeGroups.title: Traditional villages
placeGroups.intro: Tall thatched roofs, stone tombs and hand-woven ikat cloth. These villages are lived in, so it helps to visit with someone who can introduce you.

photos.alt: Tall thatched roofs rising behind flat stone tombs in a traditional village
A visitor looks at woven ikat cloths beside a wall of buffalo horns inside a traditional house

placeGroups.title: Waterfalls
placeGroups.intro: Cool pools for swimming, some a short walk from the road and some a longer hike through forest.

places.name: Lapopu waterfall
places.note: A tall stepped waterfall, about 90 metres high, inside Manupeu Tanah Daru National Park.

places.name: Mata Yangu waterfall
places.note: Reached by a walk through forest, ending at a blue waterfall and a teal pool.

places.name: Tanggedu waterfall
places.note: Often called the Grand Canyon of East Sumba. About two hours from Waingapu, then a walk.

photos.alt: A waterfall dropping into a turquoise pool surrounded by forest
A waterfall falling from a cliff into a turquoise pool, with a wooden stairway leading down
A small tiered waterfall flowing into a green pool

placeGroups.title: Weekuri lagoon
placeGroups.intro: Clear turquoise water held inside a ring of limestone rock, right beside the open sea.

photos.alt: Turquoise lagoon edged by grey limestone rocks and green trees
The lagoon under a wide blue sky, seen from the rocks above

placeGroups.title: Beaches
placeGroups.intro: White sand and blue water, with plenty of room to spread out.

places.name: Walakiri beach
places.note: A white sand beach that is popular at sunset.

photos.alt: Turquoise sea and white sand seen through a bare tree
A white sand beach with waves rolling in and rocks at the far end

placeGroups.title: Hills and countryside
placeGroups.intro: Rolling green hills and rice fields, best with a slow drive and a few photo stops.

photos.alt: A quiet road beside bright green rice fields with hills in the distance
Green rice terraces with trees and a stream

info.title: Best time to visit
info.text: Waterfalls can be visited all year. The dry season, roughly May to October, is the most comfortable for roads and river crossings.

info.title: What to bring
info.text: Swimwear, a towel, sandals or shoes with good grip, sun protection and some cash in rupiah for entrance fees and small purchases.

info.title: Visiting villages
info.text: Ask before taking photos of people. Buying a piece of weaving is a good way to support the village.

infoPhoto.alt: A river flowing under a footbridge beside green rice fields

contactIntro: The easiest way to reach Tinus is a WhatsApp message.

steps.title: Send a message
steps.text: Tell Tinus your dates, which airport you arrive at and the places you would like to see.

steps.title: Agree the plan
steps.text: He suggests a route and confirms the price.

steps.title: Meet in Sumba
steps.text: Tinus meets you at the airport or your hotel and the trip begins.
